meta.title: HUE TO HOI AN | HAI VAN PASS | VIETNAM | TRAVEL VLOG
meta.description:
We started the week in Hue, I don't feel great but thankfully we booked a jeep tour with Roadtrippers Vietnam which I highly recommend! 

we stayed at Backhome hostel which was excellent location and room wise! 

unfortunately I'm not very well throughout the whole stay in Hoi an so sorry if the footage isn't the best!

enjoy!
